summary: Edgemode, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement with an accredited investor, under which it received $100,000 net proceeds in exchange for issuing an unsecured original-issue-discount promissory note with principal of $129,600. The note carries 15% one-time interest (22% upon default), matures April 15, 2027, and is convertible on default at 61% of the lowest trading price over the prior 20 days. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine private financing, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring is involved.
